transcript.text: bosch 24 not draining, water sitting in bottom. help
Could you tell me a bit more — what kind of appliance is it, what is it doing, and is anything showing on the display or control panel?
dishwasher, freestanding Bosch. display shows E:24. dirty water left in bottom after cycle

Thanks for letting me know about the water left at the bottom of your Bosch dishwasher. I have noted the E:24 code on the display; this step is the right place to start regardless. Please switch the machine off and unplug it first. Lay down towels and have a shallow tray or baking dish ready, as several litres of water may come out. Wear gloves, as there can be broken glass in the sump. Take out the lower rack, then twist and lift out the filter at the bottom of the tub. Rinse it under the tap and clear any food, grease or glass from the sump underneath. You might find the image in the app helpful for this process. Was the filter or sump blocked (and is it clean now), or was it already clean?
[Helpful to see: image "Where the filter is" — The filter sits in the base of the dishwasher, usually under the bottom spray arm. Twist it out anticlockwise and rinse it under a tap. Typical layout — your dishwasher may differ.]
filter was clogged, food and a bit of broken glass. cleaned it, wore gloves. drains normally now, E:24 gone

[Heading: Blocked filter / sump]
Thank you for letting us know that the dishwasher is draining properly now and the filter has been cleaned. We are glad to hear it is working normally again. The issue was likely caused by a blockage in the filter or sump area, which explains why water remained at the bottom initially. Good news is that no replacement parts are needed for this fix. Please ensure you keep the filter clean during regular maintenance to help prevent future drainage issues.
